title: Choose the /projects structure
question: Same Site Drawing Set look. The job: pick up where you left off, with setting up a new project one clear action. Desktop sketches; each card says how it folds onto a phone.

options.label: Projects beside a summary
options.lineage: the master-detail of mail and file apps, matching the new report
options.thesis: A ruled list of projects and flats on the left, each with its tally; the chosen one's state on the right: what's open, what's processing, and the next thing to do, with its report one tap away.
materials: ruled project list with tally bars
options.viewport: Header with Set up a project; left: Northfield Residency (Flat 302, 9 of 12) and Lakeview Heights (Flat 101, no letter yet); right: Flat 302's open items (Kitchen: film 5 s; Bedroom 2: Short 2), its documents and clips, and Open the report. Phone: list first, a project opens its summary below.
options.risk: With one or two projects the list half is thin; the summary has to carry the page.

raised.raise: Act on one open item and the next is already waiting in the same spot.
Fewer boxes: the list is set type on rules, not cards.
Outcome colours as a strict system, the same as the report.
Each project's tally is exact: one segment per claimed item.
The list shows every project's extent at once: flats, rooms, open count.
Choosing a project changes the summary in place, no page load.

options.label: The punch list
options.lineage: a site punch list: everything left to close, across every job
options.thesis: The page opens on one list of what needs you across all projects, most urgent first, each with its one action; the projects index sits beneath.
options.viewport: '3 things need you': Flat 302 Kitchen, film 5 s (Send to site); Flat 302 Bedroom 2, Short 2 (Explain); Lakeview Flat 101, upload the demand letter (Upload). Below, the projects index with tallies. Phone: the same list, one action per row.
options.risk: When nothing is open the page goes quiet; it needs a good 'all clear' state.

options.label: Project cards with tallies
options.lineage: the familiar card grid, in the drawing set
options.thesis: One square card per project and flat, each with its tally bar, open count and the next action, in a grid; set up a project is the first card.
options.viewport: A grid: Set up a project (dashed card), Northfield Residency Flat 302 (tally 9 · 2 · 1, 2 open, Open report), Lakeview Heights Flat 101 (no letter yet, Upload). Phone: cards stack.
options.risk: The card grid is what most apps ship; it scans well but says less about what to do first.

options.label: Vertical feed
options.thesis: One project per full screen, swipe for the next.
options.case: Declined: hides every other project; builders need to see all their jobs.
options.kept: The next item waits one step away.

options.label: Metro tiles
options.thesis: Flat colour tiles and giant lowercase.
options.case: Declined: colour fields would fight the outcome colours.
options.kept: Type on rules instead of boxes.

options.label: Transit diagram
options.thesis: Projects as lines, stages as stations.
options.viewport: Stage stations along each project line.
options.case: Declined: stages aren't a journey every flat takes in order.

options.label: Acetate manual
options.case: Declined: shadows and acetate fight the flat drawing set.
options.kept: The whole extent visible at once.

options.label: Type specimen
options.thesis: A slider morphs the projects grid.
